Name: Gretchen
Dialog: (offscreen) So we all need to be prepared.

Name: Gretchen (cont'd)
Dialog: You want to find a safe place and establish a defensive perimeter.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Like in the basement?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: No! You never go in the basement!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is going on here?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: It's just our bi-monthly Zombie Apocalypse preparedness lecture.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! You're welcome to join us. You might learn something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Puh-leez, Phineas. There's nothing about zombies that I don't know.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Did you know there's one standing behind you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH!! ...Very funny.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ha! Good one, bro.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Phineas, Pinky's missing!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Aw, that's too bad, Isabella.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chihuahuas, that's the first thing zombies go for.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, we moved past zombies, Buford.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He's been gone all morning! He didn't even touch his breakfast burrito. What am I going to do?

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: We could put up posters.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We could do nothing.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could make a portable positronic canine detector using the olfactory receptors that Ferb and I were gonna use for our milligram scale purification study.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's do that one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You kids have fun. Really, I wish I could stay and bust you but I have a lunch date with Jeremy down at City Hall.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: City Hall serves lunch?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I thought they only served subpoenas! (pause) Oh, come on! What's a guy gotta do to get a rimshot around here?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: For your information, I'm going down to City Hall because Jeremy's working the Slushy Dawg concession stand at the food court there. And we're gonna have lunch...together. But don't worry, Isabella. I'm sure Pinky'll turn up. Perry always does. Speaking of which, where is Perry?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And where's Pinky?

Name: Buford
Dialog: And where's that breakfast burrito? (Baljeet plays a rimshot on the drums.) Ah, there's my guy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. I believe you know Agent Pinky. (Cut to a shot of Agent Pinky, shaking, next to Agent P.) Agent Pinky informs us that Doof intends to steal the deed to the Tri-State Area from the City Hall archives. It seems he's discovered that whoever has the deed automatically becomes the ruler. It's an old law from a simpler time. You'll find that Agent Pinky is quite an asset, Agent P. He's good with computers, covert ops, and, quite frankly, he needs the hours. So get out there and stop Doofenshmirtz! Good luck, Agents P and, uh...P! (Agents P and Pinky leave) I guess you're just two "P's" in a pod. (chuckles) Carl, where's my rimshot?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (offscreen) It's right in front of you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (picks up a flyer with the words "Ba-Dum Crash" and a picture of a snare drum on it) How did you do that?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now I am here, but the best way to the food court is...

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Is by taking the mandatory City Hall tour!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Wouldn't want a bunch of uninformed people wandering around City Hall!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—

Name: Tourist
Dialog: You can't fight it. I've been on this tour since this morning and I've been caught trying to escape twice!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: (strictly) No talking back there! (enthusiastically) Now, follow me to a world of bureaucratic action and adventure!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? No way! What a coincidence! (to the person behind him) Excuse me, if you and your mullet would just take one step to the... Thank you. (to Perry) Oh, look! You brought your little dog, too! How cute! Oh, FYI, I don't think they allow dogs in here. So, y'know, watch out for that. Anyway, I bet you're wondering why I'm in City Hall, right? Well, I plan to go down into the secret City Hall vault and steal the— Oh, you-you knew that, right. (huffs) Right, right, of course. 'Cause that's probably why you're here. To stop me, right? (opening his box) What you probably don't know is how I will get into the vault without being noticed. (takes out an inator helmet from the box) Behold! My Blend-Into-The-Background-inator. I will be able to search the vault and steal the hidden deed, because, like they say, it's easier to find a hidden object when you're hidden as well. What? Th-Th-That's a thing. They say that. Anyway, (puts helmet on) I place the inator on my head, like so, I press this button and, I-I'm here (disappears) and now I'm blended in (becomes visible again) I'm here, (disappears) I'm gone! (reappears) I'm here, I'm go— Oh, my head! I-I-I hope there's no long-term damage from this, but—ugh! Anyway, I bet you think I forgot to trap you. Well, surprise! You're already trapped... by bureaucracy! You see, you don't have a number, Perry the Platypus, so by the time you and your little dog get into the archives, I will already be ruler (disappears) of the Tri-State Area!! (He laughs and exits)

Name: Female Bureaucrat
Dialog: I'm sorry, you cannot go in there without a number, sir. (Pinky slides behind him.) Oh, please don't tell me you brought your dog!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Behold, the Dog Sensomatic Helmet! It will amplify Buford's senses to those of a dog. (The helmet drops onto Buford's head.) Okay, Buford, uh, what do you smell now?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think I can smell the future!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's working!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Do you smell Pinky yet?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I smell somethin'! (sniffs) I smell... (sniffs and runs off) I smell bacon!

Name: Baljeet and Isabella
Dialog: No, Buford, wait!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Now, this is a very old painting depicting John P. Trystate and Otto H. Adjacent—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me, I just need to get to the food court.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Please hold all your questions til the end. Those are the rules. (Candace walks backwards) And also, please refrain from gum chewing and there are no pets allowed on the tour. Also there are no cutsies or halfsies for funsies. (Candace attempts to unhook one of the velvet ropes.) And absolutely no crossing the stanchions, please! ¡No cruzar la cuerda por favor!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: To the basement! (a man walks up to the buttons and attempts to press up) Aah! Quit it! Fresh! (looks at the buttons) Alright, let's see, garage, basement, catacombs, pessimistic humanoid underground dwellings...Ah! Here it is

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Who's a good boy?!Who's a good boy?!You're a good boy!Yes, you are!Yes, you are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's me, right?I'm a good boy?You mean me, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Isabella, how does this help us with Pinky?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Easy, I've been rubbing his belly with Pinky's squeak toy. Now he's got the scent!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pointing) He's this way! I can smell it!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good boy!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! I'm a good boy, right?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes, you are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh? Oh! That had better not be the mailman!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (chasing after him) No, Buford, you're supposed to be finding Pinky!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Agh! What kind of elevator falls at the speed of gravity? Why did they even put an elevator there? I could just jump down the shaft or... (gasps) The deed! Well, I guess it's not...not all that hidden, then, is it? Well, maybe it's just easier to find 'cause I'm hidden! Yes, I (reappears) knew that was a real saying! Come to Papa! (gasps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! Oh, and-and your pet dog. How did you escape the clutches of bureaucracy? (Perry holds up a piece of paper with the number "7" on it.) Oh, oh, you took a number. I guess the line wasn't as long as I thought. But you're too late! (disappears again) Once I get outside, I will own the Tri-State Area! (Pinky kicks Doof into the ground as he reappears again and a bunch of rolled up papers fall on the ground) Wait Which one is it? Oh, great, now I'm confused!!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: And over here are the spontaneous musical number dioramas.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The huh?

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Ooh, Danville is known for its spontaneous musical numbers. For instance...

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: And now, step this way for the history of the history of accounting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's see, the Declaration of Independence, the Magna Carta, the Deed to the Tri-State Are—I mean the Mayflower Compact? Ha ha! (goes in the elevator with the "Mayflower Compact" and disappears) Goodbye, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh! Oh! In here! Follow Buford!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, you guys, he went here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think Buford found him!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really? A doggy door in a municipal building that does not allow dogs?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? He- Who did that?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: This way, everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see, how do you get outta here, now? (Perry swipes the inator off of Doof.) Hey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh? Another dog! Dis way! (He jumps forward)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, I hope it's Pinky!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Right here! Right here, he—What? (takes off his helmet) He should be right here! Oh, man!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't get it. Maybe the helmet needs to be fine-tuned.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (puts helmet on the floor) Yeah, you guys do that. I'm gonna go get a Slushy Dawg.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: R-I-D-E, colon. (The text "PASSWORD

Name: Major Monogram's Voice
Dialog: Agent Pinky is good with computers...good with computers...good with computers...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! That guy is really good with computers!

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Now who's ready to see the whole tour again?

Name: All but Candace
Dialog: Run!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually, the song part was nice.

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Oh, ya like the song, do ya? Well... (As he's about to sing again, Pinky, back in mindless animal mode, walks up to Candace) Hey! Hold it! Is that a dog?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, it's Pinky! (picks him up)

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: I'm sorry, no dogs allowed! This tour is officially over!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (running up to Candace) Candace! Candace, you found him! Thank you! (Candace gives Pinky to Isabella) You said he'd turn up and he did!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Way to go, Candace! (picks up Perry) C'mon, you two wandering pets! Who wants a breakfast burrito?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly how long have you worked here at City Hall?

Name: Tour Guide
Dialog: Oh, I don't work here. I was sent by Yarnak to help uninformed citizens in need! Now, if you'll excuse me, I am needed elsewhere! Whoosh! (he runs off)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace! Where were you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm sorry I missed lunch, Jeremy, but this weird guy made me go on a tour.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's Don. He's, uh, kind of a fixture around here.

Name: Don
Dialog: I'm the ruler of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, now I'm confused!
